findings.resolution: REQ-MEM-002 now specifies storage of the exact supplied formatter with return None, no truth test or format call on installation, and selection on explicit use. A spy observed no calls on installation or forwarding, then one truth test and one format(A) on explicit use. A false formatter selected the default; a raising truth hook propagated only on explicit formatting.
